# Gifts of Khaine

*Page PDF 68*

## **Gifts of Khaine**
In battle, Khaine’s most dedicated followers can focus their devotion to bring inspiration from their god to aid them in their slaughter. These abilities are part technique, part religious rite, and part strict regimen. 

## **Talent: Gifts of Khaine**
The acolyte of Khaine is so devoted that they can invoke his secret names to channel his unholy influence against their victims, confusing and terrifying them before their inevitable evisceration. If this Character draws blood from an opponent using a Melee Skill, they can take a **Challenging (+0) Weapon Skill** Test to use a Gift of Khaine as a Free Action. They must succeed by the appropriate SL to use the gift. Blows that kill an opponent add +2 SL. By spending a Fortune Point, they may invoke a Gift without a Test. 

Using a Gift of Khaine puts any high elf automatically into the Dark Yenlui state ( **High Elf Players Guide** , page 46). 

## **Cry of War**
## **Requires 4 Sl**
The Khainite shrieks one of the hidden names of Khaine, terrifying their foes with primal dread of their impending doom. They gain the _Terror_ Trait against any opponent within weapon range. 

## **Dance of Doom**
## **Requires 1 Sl**
The Khainite makes a dramatic flourish to cast the gore from their weapon into the air. They dance through the blood and flesh as it falls upon them. They add +2 SL to any Dodge Tests they make until their next Turn. 

## **Dagger of Khaine**
## **Requires 1 Sl**
The Khainite whispers one of Khaine’s secret names to their blade, granting its edge fresh and death-dealing sacrament. The imbued weapon gains the _Damaging_ , _Magical_ , and _Precise_ Qualities until the end of its wielder’s next turn. 

## **Eternal Torment**
## **Requires 3 Sl**
The Khainite wipes lifeblood from their blade, dragging their victim’s soul into the clutches of Khaine. This Gift can only be used following an attack that kills. The body cannot be revived by necromancy, nor can their soul be contacted using magic. It is in Khaine’s realm, where they will scream for eternity. The Khainite gains 1 Fortune Point. 

## **Hand of Khaine**
## **Requires 1 Sl**
Fresh blood drips as the Khainite traces a complex pattern with their blade. Their victim, enthralled by the sight, begins to welcome evisceration. Make an **Opposed Perform (Dancing)/ Cool** Test. If the Khainite wins, the target is _Surprised_ . 

## **Hidden Blade**
## **Requires 2 Sl**
Partly-obscured by the spray of blood, a dagger strikes from an impossible angle. Counts as an additional free attack from a dagger using the Khainite’s Melee (Basic) Skill. 

## **Sting in the Tail**
## **Requires 2 Sl**
Invoking Khaine in his aspect of the scorpion, the Khainite licks blood from their weapon. Their saliva mingles with the fresh blood, creating a vicious poison. For the next 6 Rounds, the Khainite’s weapon inflicts a _Poisoned_ Condition every time it causes Damage. 

## **Touch of Khaine**
## **Requires 2 Sl**
The Khainite’s blood rushes hot as the god’s will propels their hand. Until the end of their next Turn, they add +3 SL to any Melee Tests they make.
